discovered_items.eligibility: Enrolled students aged 16+ in India (13+ in US) at accredited schools/universities.
discovered_items.geography: Global (Online + Cupertino WWDC Trip for Distinguished Winners)
discovered_items.stipend: AirPods Max / Apple hardware, 1-year Apple Developer Program membership, WWDC travel for top 50

discovered_items.mentor_notes: Several Indian undergraduate students are selected among the 350 global winners every year.
discovered_items.target_persona: iOS, Swift, UI/UX, and mobile app builders.
